**Estate readiness software for advisors, families, executors, and estate teams**

ABOUT JOSDA

Estate planning is often treated as a legal\\-document problem. In real life, families need much more than documents. They need clear access to accounts, debts, documents, contacts, instructions, digital information, and trusted workflows at the moments when confusion is most costly.

Josda is building for sensitive, high\\-trust situations where product clarity, security, reliability, and human\\-centered design matter. Our goal is to make estate planning and estate administration more usable for advisors, families, executors, and estate teams.

You will work across the stack, influence product decisions, make architecture choices, improve the customer experience, and ship features that directly affect how families and advisors use Josda.

* Agentic coding fluency with tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex\\-style workflows, or similar AI development systems; able to verify, test, and improve AI\\-generated work.
* Product and UX judgment including clear flows, strong copy, edge cases, accessibility basics, loading/error states, and empathy for non\\-technical users under stress.
* Security\\-minded engineering with strong instincts around privacy, sensitive data, authentication, authorization, auditability, and reliability.

NICE\\-TO\\-HAVE SKILL AREAS

* Estate, fintech, legaltech, or advisor platforms especially products involving regulated, financial, legal, or high\\-trust workflows.
* AI product experience including RAG, OpenAI APIs, chat interfaces, document search, summarization, prompt/service design, or human\\-in\\-the\\-loop workflow design.
* AWS depth with CDK, Cognito, RDS, S3, CloudFront, ECS/Fargate, Lambda, SQS, OpenSearch, Textract, SES, WAF, or similar managed services.
* Payments and financial integrations such as Stripe subscriptions, billing UX, Plaid, account linking, financial data processing, or webhook\\-driven systems.
* Document\\-heavy products with upload, OCR/extraction, categorization, permissions, audit trails, search, review, and secure sharing.
* Early\\-stage startup experience where broad ownership, fast iteration, product sense, and pragmatic tradeoffs matter more than narrow specialization.

WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR

Reporting to the SVP of Technology within the DevOps team, you will partner closely with two data analysts and our full\\-stack developers. * Semantic Layer: Partner with Full Stack Developers to build a semantic layer over BigQuery, enabling governed, AI\\-queryable access to data domains.
* RAG Architecture: Build and optimize data stores for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) to power BRUNT's next generation of intelligent applications.
* Cross\\-Functional Support: Partner with data analysts to ensure gold\\-tier datasets are performant and well\\-structured for Looker Studio dashboards, managing your workflow via Jira within an Agile sprint cadence.
* Serve as the technical data engineering point of contact within the DevOps team, translating business\\-driven data requirements into engineering specifications and delivery plans.

  


**WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED:**


* Experience: 4–7 years of data engineering experience with demonstrated ownership of production data pipelines, cloud warehouses, and ELT/ETL architectures.
* The BigQuery Core: Strong hands\\-on proficiency with Google BigQuery, including schema design, query optimization, partitioning, clustering, and GCP cost management.
* Data Ingestion \\& Coding: Advanced SQL skills (ability to audit and refactor complex legacy stored procedures) paired with proficiency in Python for API\\-based ingestion and automation.
* Tooling Stack: Deep experience administering managed ingestion platforms like Fivetran and a strong working knowledge of dbt for transformation layer testing and documentation.
* AI Architecture (Preferred): Familiarity with Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) data structures and experience building semantic layers for LLM or AI agent consumption.
* Governance \\& Security: Working knowledge of cloud data governance, including PII handling, column\\-level security, and access control implementation.
* Infrastructure \\& BI: Familiarity with Terraform for infrastructure\\-as\\-code and Looker Studio (or similar BI tools) to ensure gold\\-tier data yields performant reporting.
* The "Builder" Mindset: A proven track record of operating as a senior individual contributor in lean environments, with a knack for inheriting, auditing, and modernizing legacy data systems.
* Team Cadence: Experience working within Agile/Scrum sprint frameworks using Jira, alongside strong technical writing skills for mapping data lineage and runbooks.
* Logistics: Must be 18\\+ with full\\-time availability (including occasional off\\-hours support for critical pipeline incidents) and the ability to reliably commute to the office 4x per week

* Flexible work from home or in\\-office
